decks.domain: Following, merging, crossing and passing space

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Measure following time from when the leading vehicle’s rear passes a fixed roadside point ____.
cards.back: Measure following time from when the leading vehicle’s rear passes a fixed roadside point until your vehicle reaches that point.
cards.memory_hook: until your vehicle reaches that point

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: If your vehicle reaches the marker before three seconds pass, fall back and repeat the check until the ____.
cards.back: If your vehicle reaches the marker before three seconds pass, fall back and repeat the check until the gap reaches at least three seconds.
cards.memory_hook: gap reaches at least three seconds

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Some conditions can require more than the baseline following space; the handbook says ____.
cards.back: Some conditions can require more than the baseline following space; the handbook says a four-second gap may be needed.
cards.memory_hook: a four-second gap may be needed

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Increase following space on slippery roads because stopping ____.
cards.back: Increase following space on slippery roads because stopping takes more distance.
cards.memory_hook: takes more distance

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: If a following driver wants to pass, slow to create room ahead ____.
cards.back: If a following driver wants to pass, slow to create room ahead and help the pass finish sooner.
cards.memory_hook: and help the pass finish sooner

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Leave extra room behind motorcycles in case the rider falls, particularly on ____.
cards.back: Leave extra room behind motorcycles in case the rider falls, particularly on wet, icy, gravel or metal surfaces.
cards.memory_hook: wet, icy, gravel or metal surfaces

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Fall farther behind vehicles whose drivers may not see you, including trucks, buses, vans ____.
cards.back: Fall farther behind vehicles whose drivers may not see you, including trucks, buses, vans and vehicles towing campers or trailers.
cards.memory_hook: and vehicles towing campers or trailers

decks.domain: Following, merging, crossing and passing space

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A larger gap behind a large vehicle improves the view ahead and ____.
cards.back: A larger gap behind a large vehicle improves the view ahead and the chance of being seen.
cards.memory_hook: the chance of being seen

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A heavy load or towed trailer increases stopping distance and ____.
cards.back: A heavy load or towed trailer increases stopping distance and calls for more following space.
cards.memory_hook: calls for more following space

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Increase following distance when darkness or bad weather makes the ____.
cards.back: Increase following distance when darkness or bad weather makes the road ahead hard to see.
cards.memory_hook: road ahead hard to see

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: When tailgated, try to create additional space ahead so braking ____.
cards.back: When tailgated, try to create additional space ahead so braking can be less abrupt.
cards.memory_hook: can be less abrupt

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Leave extra room behind police, ambulance and fire vehicles because ____.
cards.back: Leave extra room behind police, ambulance and fire vehicles because they need operating space.
cards.memory_hook: they need operating space

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Near rail crossings, leave additional room behind vehicles that must stop there, including transit ____.
cards.back: Near rail crossings, leave additional room behind vehicles that must stop there, including transit buses, school buses and hazardous-material carriers.
cards.memory_hook: buses, school buses and hazardous-material carriers

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: When stopped uphill, leave room for the vehicle ahead to ____.
cards.back: When stopped uphill, leave room for the vehicle ahead to roll backward as it starts.
cards.memory_hook: roll backward as it starts

decks.module: Communication and clearance beside road users
decks.domain: Following, merging, crossing and passing space

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Maintain a steady speed and signal slowing or turns early to help ____.
cards.back: Maintain a steady speed and signal slowing or turns early to help following drivers keep a safe gap.
cards.memory_hook: following drivers keep a safe gap

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Pick up or release passengers at a safe ____.
cards.back: Pick up or release passengers at a safe stopping place outside traffic.
cards.memory_hook: stopping place outside traffic

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Before parallel parking with traffic behind, signal, draw beside the space and ____.
cards.back: Before parallel parking with traffic behind, signal, draw beside the space and allow following vehicles to pass.
cards.memory_hook: allow following vehicles to pass

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: If necessary slow travel delays others, pull aside safely and let them ____.
cards.back: If necessary slow travel delays others, pull aside safely and let them pass, using a turnout where available.
cards.memory_hook: pass, using a turnout where available

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: If tailgated and a right lane is available, move right; without one, wait for a clear ____.
cards.back: If tailgated and a right lane is available, move right; without one, wait for a clear road ahead and gradually reduce speed.
cards.memory_hook: road ahead and gradually reduce speed

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Never brake abruptly to discourage a tailgater because ____.
cards.back: Never brake abruptly to discourage a tailgater because this increases rear-impact risk.
cards.memory_hook: this increases rear-impact risk

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Maintain side space and avoid remaining alongside another vehicle where it could ____.
cards.back: Maintain side space and avoid remaining alongside another vehicle where it could crowd or enter your lane.
cards.memory_hook: crowd or enter your lane

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Leave as much safe room as possible from opposing vehicles; on a two-lane ____.
cards.back: Leave as much safe room as possible from opposing vehicles; on a two-lane road, avoid hugging the center line.
cards.memory_hook: road, avoid hugging the center line

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The handbook generally recommends driving in the center ____.
cards.back: The handbook generally recommends driving in the center of the lane.
cards.memory_hook: of the lane

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: On a multilane road, make room for entering traffic by moving over ____.
cards.back: On a multilane road, make room for entering traffic by moving over when the neighboring lane is clear.
cards.memory_hook: when the neighboring lane is clear

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Leave extra clearance beside parked cars because doors, pedestrians or the vehicles ____.
cards.back: Leave extra clearance beside parked cars because doors, pedestrians or the vehicles themselves may enter your path.
cards.memory_hook: themselves may enter your path

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Allow extra room for pedestrians and cyclists, especially children, because they ____.
cards.back: Allow extra room for pedestrians and cyclists, especially children, because they can enter the path suddenly.
cards.memory_hook: can enter the path suddenly

decks.domain: Following, merging, crossing and passing space

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: When vulnerable users are not involved, the handbook advises a middle course between two hazards, with additional ____.
cards.back: When vulnerable users are not involved, the handbook advises a middle course between two hazards, with additional clearance toward the more dangerous side.
cards.memory_hook: clearance toward the more dangerous side

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Address hazards separately when possible; if an opposing vehicle approaches while you intend to pass a bicycle, ____.
cards.back: Address hazards separately when possible; if an opposing vehicle approaches while you intend to pass a bicycle, slow and let it pass first.
cards.memory_hook: slow and let it pass first

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: When passing a cyclist, preserve at least three feet of clearance and use the neighboring lane ____.
cards.back: When passing a cyclist, preserve at least three feet of clearance and use the neighboring lane on a multilane road whenever possible.
cards.memory_hook: on a multilane road whenever possible

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Do not merge into an undersized gap; choose enough room to ____.
cards.back: Do not merge into an undersized gap; choose enough room to maintain a safe space cushion.
cards.memory_hook: maintain a safe space cushion

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: When crossing several lanes, change one lane at a time rather than trying ____.
cards.back: When crossing several lanes, change one lane at a time rather than trying to cross them all at once.
cards.memory_hook: to cross them all at once

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A crossing maneuver needs room to clear the whole road, while entry ____.
cards.back: A crossing maneuver needs room to clear the whole road, while entry needs room to turn and accelerate.
cards.memory_hook: needs room to turn and accelerate

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Stop partway across only in a median large enough to contain the ____.
cards.back: Stop partway across only in a median large enough to contain the entire vehicle without protruding into traffic.
cards.memory_hook: entire vehicle without protruding into traffic

decks.domain: Following, merging, crossing and passing space

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Before turning left across opposing traffic, ensure the intended path is not ____.
cards.back: Before turning left across opposing traffic, ensure the intended path is not blocked by vehicles or pedestrians.
cards.memory_hook: blocked by vehicles or pedestrians

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Do not enter a blocked intersection even on green; blocking it ____.
cards.back: Do not enter a blocked intersection even on green; blocking it can result in a ticket.
cards.memory_hook: can result in a ticket

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Do not assume another driver will create a gap or turn because a signal is flashing; wait for the turn to ____.
cards.back: Do not assume another driver will create a gap or turn because a signal is flashing; wait for the turn to begin and proceed only when safe.
cards.memory_hook: begin and proceed only when safe

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A motorcycle’s signal may remain on from an earlier turn because ____.
cards.back: A motorcycle’s signal may remain on from an earlier turn because it may not cancel automatically.
cards.memory_hook: it may not cancel automatically

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Cross rail tracks only when you can clear them without ____.
cards.back: Cross rail tracks only when you can clear them without stopping on the tracks.
cards.memory_hook: stopping on the tracks

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Pass only where signs and markings permit and there is enough space; the handbook generally recommends ____.
cards.back: Pass only where signs and markings permit and there is enough space; the handbook generally recommends passing one vehicle at a time.
cards.memory_hook: passing one vehicle at a time

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The handbook’s passing example at fifty-five miles per hour calls for roughly ten seconds of clear opposing traffic and sight distance, with the driver ____.
cards.back: The handbook’s passing example at fifty-five miles per hour calls for roughly ten seconds of clear opposing traffic and sight distance, with the driver still judging whether space is adequate.
cards.memory_hook: still judging whether space is adequate

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: At fifty-five miles per hour, a vehicle covers more than eight ____.
cards.back: At fifty-five miles per hour, a vehicle covers more than eight hundred feet in ten seconds.
cards.memory_hook: hundred feet in ten seconds

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: When both vehicles in the example travel at fifty-five miles per hour, together they cover over one thousand six hundred feet during ten seconds; uncertainty about ____.
cards.back: When both vehicles in the example travel at fifty-five miles per hour, together they cover over one thousand six hundred feet during ten seconds; uncertainty about adequate passing space calls for waiting.
cards.memory_hook: adequate passing space calls for waiting

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The handbook advises against beginning a pass within one-third mile of a view-blocking hill or curve ____.
cards.back: The handbook advises against beginning a pass within one-third mile of a view-blocking hill or curve because opposing traffic may be hidden.
cards.memory_hook: because opposing traffic may be hidden

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Passing near intersections, rail crossings or shopping-area entrances is dangerous because other road users can enter ____.
cards.back: Passing near intersections, rail crossings or shopping-area entrances is dangerous because other road users can enter unseen or not expect opposing-lane traffic.
cards.memory_hook: unseen or not expect opposing-lane traffic

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Before passing, look for roadway restrictions or traffic that could push another ____.
cards.back: Before passing, look for roadway restrictions or traffic that could push another vehicle into the passing space.
cards.memory_hook: vehicle into the passing space

decks.module: Passing restrictions and allowing safe merges
decks.domain: Following, merging, crossing and passing space

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: People or bicycles near the road, a narrowed bridge, ice, potholes or other ____.
cards.back: People or bicycles near the road, a narrowed bridge, ice, potholes or other obstructions can reduce available passing space.
cards.memory_hook: obstructions can reduce available passing space

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Do not pass unless there is room to return to the proper lane without relying ____.
cards.back: Do not pass unless there is room to return to the proper lane without relying on other drivers to make space.
cards.memory_hook: on other drivers to make space

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Do not pass with a railroad ____.
cards.back: Do not pass with a railroad crossing ahead.
cards.memory_hook: crossing ahead

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Before returning after a pass, leave adequate clearance; the handbook uses seeing both passed-vehicle headlights in the ____.
cards.back: Before returning after a pass, leave adequate clearance; the handbook uses seeing both passed-vehicle headlights in the rear-view mirror as a clearance cue.
cards.memory_hook: rear-view mirror as a clearance cue

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Allow extra room for drivers with obstructed views ____.
cards.back: Allow extra room for drivers with obstructed views at intersections or driveways.
cards.memory_hook: at intersections or driveways

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Give extra room to drivers reversing into the road or entering and leaving parking spaces ____.
cards.back: Give extra room to drivers reversing into the road or entering and leaving parking spaces because they may not see you.
cards.memory_hook: because they may not see you

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Drivers with obscured windows and pedestrians with faces hidden by hats or ____.
cards.back: Drivers with obscured windows and pedestrians with faces hidden by hats or umbrellas may need extra space.
cards.memory_hook: umbrellas may need extra space

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Allow additional room or caution around distracted people, including delivery workers, construction ____.
cards.back: Allow additional room or caution around distracted people, including delivery workers, construction workers, inattentive children and drivers.
cards.memory_hook: workers, inattentive children and drivers

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Give extra room to potentially confused drivers, such as those searching for addresses, slowing ____.
cards.back: Give extra room to potentially confused drivers, such as those searching for addresses, slowing inexplicably or appearing unsure of direction.
cards.memory_hook: inexplicably or appearing unsure of direction

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: If another driver attempts a pass without enough room, slow and allow a safe return ____.
cards.back: If another driver attempts a pass without enough room, slow and allow a safe return rather than making the mistake worse.
cards.memory_hook: rather than making the mistake worse

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: If a driver suddenly needs to change lanes, slow to allow the merge ____.
cards.back: If a driver suddenly needs to change lanes, slow to allow the merge when needed to avoid a collision.
cards.memory_hook: when needed to avoid a collision
